title: Credential rebinding
note: An archive carries data, not continuing access authority: import revokes copied API tokens and browser sessions. Local import grants the current machine owner local admin authority without issuing a server token. Self-host import returns one fresh org-admin token, shown once, for connecting to the destination server; protect it as a secret. Hosted import establishes access through destination authority, so reconnect clients and sign in again rather than reusing source credentials.
